title: RevMed Says No to Being Bought: Biotech's Independent Era
summary: Revolution Medicines is choosing not to make a sale its priority. The decision reflects a broader shift: top-tier biotech companies with breakthrough assets may once again have a credible path to grow into independent biopharma companies.
